name: Bank of The Ryukyus, Limited
summary: Bank of The Ryukyus, Limited provides various banking products and services in Japan. It operates through the Banking, Lease, Credit Card, Credit Guarantee Business, and IT Business segments. The company offers savings, comprehensive, guardiamship support, time, fixed term, and property deposits; loan products, including housing, reverse mortgage, apartment, car, education, personal, card, and Ippo consolidated loans; and insurance products, such as individual annuity, whole life, medical, long-term care, term life, fire, pet, and cancer insurance.
